description: Land Title Settlement Department - Waththala, Waththala D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 512000 (23/0262)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed property descriptions, ownership details, parcel numbers, extents, and encumbrances. The content focuses entirely on land registration and title settlement processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land ownership, title determinations, and property registrations.
